checks.name: founder_note
checks.heading: A note from Ekene
checks.text:
Radar by Thally

Hi Alex,

A note from Ekene

I’m Ekene, Radar’s founder.

It’s never been easier to build a product. But getting it beyond your own network is still a full-time job.

That’s why we built Radar. We wanted to take on the marketing work that helps good products reach the people who need them.

If you get stuck or anything is unclear, reply here. I’m happy to help.

Ekene

Reply to Ekene

Reply to this email or write to team@thally.io.

checks.heading: 3 days to try Radar
checks.text:
Radar by Thally

Hi Alex,

3 days to try Radar

Your trial ends on November 7, 2026 at 12:00 PM UTC.

The $1.00 you paid to confirm your card comes off your first month. That’s normally $49.00, then $50.00/month. Any tax or other adjustments will be shown on your invoice.

If you don’t want to continue, cancel in Settings → Billing before the trial ends. Otherwise, your subscription will renew automatically.

Manage subscription

Reply to this email or write to support@thally.io.
